notes: Exact duplicate removal assumes identical full rows are repeated records; no line ID is supplied.
Gross sales exclude returns. Concatenate sales and returns for signed net transaction amounts.
Signed net transaction amounts are not accounting profit and exclude invalid/free/adjustment rows.
Customer counts use distinct nonmissing CustomerID; unidentified sales remain in sales totals.
Country labels are preserved; Unspecified is an unknown category, not a real country.
Service/adjustment flags identify known codes only; validate other unusual codes before product ranking.
Some extreme sales have offsetting cancellations; review net quantities before product ranking.
No currency column is present; amounts use original price units without currency conversion.
Dates are timezone-naive; no timezone was inferred. December 2011 is only partially covered.
